command: godot --path engine/greybox -s tools/drive_boxing_motion.gd -- welcome anatomy-only capture

contract.step_realization: directed startup travel; no contact-range bonus
contract.recoil: pre-push contact held through hitstop; presentation release over 12 active ticks; simulated push unchanged

coverage: Ten rows and both hands; inside/edge/missed head and body targets
Both actors; four style packages; slip, duck, lean and weave targets
Fixed arm/leg lengths and rendered elbow/knee/ankle/glove/abdomen attachment
Close straights fold; edge straights extend; hooks retain elbow flexion
Continuous hook recovery and covered elbow through delayed feint/lunge
Step-in travel halts in hitstop and cancels with feint
Shared uniform single/exhibition ring mapping; unchanged camera framing criteria

observations: Side view shows the delivered glove against the head without changing arm length.
Hip/abdomen/torso, shoulder/elbow and knee/boot links stay joined in retained frames.
Front view includes normal opponent occlusion; side and chase views expose the delivered arm.
The final rig preserves hit/drop/feint/taunt impulses through connected anchors.
Diagnostic capture fixtures retain some stale HUD feedback from prior simulated setups; images are anatomy evidence, not a fresh-player usability session.

limitations: Procedural anatomy remains a development rig. This does not certify professional boxing authenticity or player enjoyment.
Foot plant and weight-transfer refinement is PAC-202C; style/build presentation is PAC-202E. Parent PAC-202 and full ecosystem OGM-025 remain open.
No physical controller latency or manual sustained play acceptance was performed.
